# HearthCode

HearthCode provides warm dark and light themes built from the HearthCode color system. Charcoal and paper surfaces are paired with a restrained, editorial syntax palette that the recorded description tunes for long reading and writing sessions.

![HearthCode screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hearth-code/hearthcode-obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "HearthCode"
    author: "HearthCode"
    repo:   "hearth-code/hearthcode-obsidian"
    slug:   "hearthcode"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/hearthcode"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/hearth-code/hearthcode-obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hearth-code/hearthcode-obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply warm, calm dark and light themes built from the HearthCode color system. Use charcoal-and-paper surfaces and a restrained, editorial syntax palette tuned for long reading and writing sessions."
}
```
